task.title: Harden offline search index integrity checks
task.original_goal: Strengthen existing offline full-text index validation so damaged or missing shard data cannot pass unnoticed, without altering app runtime, content, generated assets or publishing.
task.roadmap_source: docs/OFFLINE_SEARCH_BULK_ROADMAP.md — S1 deterministic index verification and launch requirement for corrupted index diagnostics
task.scope: scripts/check_fulltext_index.py and optional isolated standard-library regression test only; existing indexing source formats unchanged.
verification_plan: Inspect existing index schema and verifier first
Run existing Python full-text verification if generated assets are present
Run standard-library regression test or a temporary-copy corruption scenario without modifying checked-in generated assets

acceptance_criteria: Verifier fails clearly on missing one of sixteen compressed shard files or malformed gzip/JSON
Verifier detects malformed shard term/postings structure, rather than reporting a false PASS
Existing legitimate index remains valid; expected document coverage and natural-language checks preserved
No Android runtime behaviour, public safety guidance, CI workflows or generated index assets modified
Tests or exact reproducible manual validation included for corruption cases

tests_unverified: Seven newly authored isolated regression cases are committed but not executed
Existing full-text index check not executed
last_handoff.result: Refinement added seven isolated fixture tests covering missing/corrupt shard, invalid JSON, malformed postings, unknown document and shard misrouting.

history.notes: Pilot task grounded in offline search roadmap; no code changed.
